text: 🇲🇽🌎 "The coup ended the first democratic government of the Revolution and was an attack on national sovereignty." "In the conspiracy, the US ambassador Henry Lane Wilson intervened; he took part in the negotiations that led to the Embassy Pact to overthrow the constitutional government." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution, Zócalo, Mexico City, Nov 20, 2026 At the 116th anniversary of the Revolution, Sheinbaum recounted the "Decena Trágica" of February 1913: Victoriano Huerta betrayed President Francisco I. Madero, who was forced to resign along with Vice President José María Pino Suárez, and both were then murdered. "It was a painful lesson. Democracy must include social justice; if not, there is no democracy."

🇲🇽✊ "The best news they can give the President of Mexico is that poverty is decreasing in Mexico." "I think some people didn't like it that much, but we should all be happy, truly, because this is very good news for the whole country." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, closing press conference of the APEC 2026 trip, Shenzhen, China, Nov 19, 2026 Asked in Shenzhen about the World Bank estimate that more than 17 million Mexicans have left poverty since 2018, Sheinbaum called it recognition of "what the moral economy means, what Mexican Humanism means, Plan México," and of what Mexico is doing so that prosperity reaches every Mexican.

🇲🇽🌎 "It is a new era, an era of cooperation that lets us improve the relationship and learn from the advances China has, and also lets China know what we are doing in Mexico." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, closing press conference of the APEC 2026 trip, Shenzhen, China, Nov 19, 2026 Mexico and China signed memorandums of understanding on environment and climate (river cleanup, solid waste), energy (solar-thermal, geothermal, storage, smart grids), science (12-month exchanges of young researchers) and international cooperation. A health agreement is in the works, and Mexico proposed 2027 as a Mexico–China Year of Tourism for 55 years of relations. Asked about Washington: "It will not affect Mexico's relationship with the United States." Mexico is not seeking a free-trade deal with China.

🇲🇽🌎 "Units of the Constitutionalist Army defeated American forces in that town." "National sovereignty is a revolutionary concept little known or discussed, but it left its mark in events where Mexican soldiers defended that principle. An example is the Battle of El Carrizal of June 21, 1916. The outcome of that battle generated social rejection of the invaders as they passed through various communities, so the American government decided to leave Mexican territory." — General Ricardo Trevilla Trejo, Secretary of National Defense, 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution, Zócalo, Nov 20, 2026 The US troops at El Carrizal were part of Pershing's Punitive Expedition. Trevilla said the battle and the later Carranza Doctrine strengthened a Mexican nationalism "preserved to this day in the people and in the Mexican Armed Forces."

🇲🇽✊ "It is not enough to have the right to choose; one must have the right to live with dignity." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution, Zócalo, Mexico City, Nov 20, 2026 The minimum wage rose 154% in real terms in 8 years, after 36 years of stagnation. 42 million people receive well-being programs directly, with a record investment of one trillion pesos. World Bank estimates put more than 17 million people out of poverty since 2018, and ECLAC's Social Panorama 2026 found that without the universal pension, poverty among adults 65 and over would be 11.5 percentage points higher. "The Revolution left a fundamental lesson: democracy and social justice are inseparable."

🔥🇲🇽 "Let it be heard loud and far: they will fail again in their attempt to delegitimize the 2027 elections." "In these two years they have tried everything to defeat the will of the people, but they have failed. They failed with their paid campaigns on social media and in the media to fabricate lies and slander. They failed a year ago with their calls to violence and by inventing fake youth mobilizations. They failed with the deliberate slander that 'this government protects criminals.' They failed by seeking foreign interference." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution, Zócalo, Mexico City, Nov 20, 2026 "We come from fighting electoral fraud. Democracy is our essence and we will never betray our own history." Her Revolution Day speech recalled the frauds of 1988 and 2006, the later burning of those ballots, and the vote-buying complaints of 2012.

🇲🇽🛒 <u>RETAIL SALES DIPPED IN SEPTEMBER, BUT 2026 IS STILL AHEAD OF 2025</u>

According to INEGI data reported by El Economista, retail sales fell 0.3% month over month in September after rising 1.2% in August. They are still up 2.6% from a year earlier, and growth for January–September was 2.8%, compared with 1.9% for the same months of 2025. Retail grew 0.5% in the third quarter, slightly faster than 0.4% in the second. Monex economists said annual growth "remained positive in most segments and in every state."

🇲🇽✈️ <u>CRITICS CALLED THE AIFA A WHITE ELEPHANT. ITS CONSTRUCTION SITE UNCOVERED 13,000 YEARS OF HISTORY</u>

INAH confirmed that Yotzin, the skeleton found in 2021 while the Felipe Ángeles International Airport was being built, is between 13,087 and 11,700 years old, based on two lab analyses in Belgium and at the University of Georgia. He is one of the 23 oldest human skeletons ever found in the Basin of Mexico: a hunter-gatherer about 1.75 m tall, buried among mammoth and prehistoric camel remains. Yotzin means "unique" in Náhuatl.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>NAFTA DROVE THE MIGRATION TRUMP NOW PUNISHES</u>

According to a Contralínea editorial, more than 11 million people of Mexican origin live in the US, and the mass exodus took off after NAFTA came into force in 1994 and left Mexico's farmers competing against heavily subsidized US agribusiness. Migrants make up 17.7% of the US workforce, about 30 million workers. Trump threatened to double tariffs on Mexico over a caravan of no more than 1,500 people. Sheinbaum replied that Mexico has broken up 24 caravans since 2024. On November 3, Republicans lost the Texas governorship.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>IN MEXICO'S SENATE: US BLOCKADE HAS DOUBLED CUBA'S INFANT MORTALITY</u>

At the 18th Mexico-Cuba Interparliamentary Meeting in Mexico's Senate, Cuban National Assembly vice president Ana María Machado said infant mortality on the island has more than doubled under the US blockade, from 4.4 to 9.9 per 1,000 live births. More than 100,000 patients are waiting for surgery, about 12,000 of them children, while containers of food and medicine sit in foreign ports because shipping companies are threatened. Senate president Higinio Martínez answered that Mexico will keep sending humanitarian aid to Cuba despite outside pressure.
